User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the system.

name.description: User's display name or nickname. This is not unique.

username.description: User's unique handle, starting with '@'. This must be unique across all users.

avatar.description: URL to the user's avatar image.

statusMessage.description: A short status message from the user.

hasSetNickname.description: True if the user has set their nickname at least once.

lastSeen.description: Server timestamp of when the user was last active.

Username.title: Username
Username.description: Maps a unique username to a user ID to enforce uniqueness.

uid.description: The user ID associated with this username.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: A single message within a chat.

senderId.description: The ID of the user who sent the message.

content.description: The text content of the message.

timestamp.description: The server timestamp when the message was created.

name.description: Name of the group or channel.

members.description: List of user IDs who are members of this chat.

ownerId.description: The user ID of the owner of the group or channel.

icon.description: Name of the lucide-react icon for the chat.

lastMessage.description: The last message sent in the chat for display in the sidebar.

unreadCounts.description: Map of user IDs to their unread message count for this chat.

link.description: Unique link for a group or channel.

ChatLink.title: Chat Link
ChatLink.description: Maps a unique chat link to a chat ID to enforce uniqueness.

chatId.description: The chat ID associated with this link.

/chats/{chatId}.description: Stores metadata for chat rooms (DMs, groups, channels).

/chats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Stores messages for a specific chat.

/chatLinks/{linkId}.description: Used to enforce unique links for groups and channels.
